Audio preprocessing and convolutions

Convert a 16 kHz waveform to 128-bin log-Mel features, then project into an audio sequence.

log-Mel[B,128,3000]Standard 30-second window; feature extraction has no model parameters.
↓
Conv1d + GELU[B,1280,3000]128→1280，kernel=3，stride=1，padding=1。
↓
Conv1d + GELU → transpose[B,1500,1280]1280→1280，kernel=3，stride=2，padding=1。
↓
Add fixed sinusoidal positional encoding[B,1500,1280]1500×1280 buffer; excluded from learnable parameters.

Audio encoder block

Non-causal self-attention and GELU FFN with two pre-LayerNorm residual branches.

Inputs from

LayerNorm → Q/K/V[B,20,1500,64]Each projection is 1280→1280; Q/V have bias, K does not.
↓
Bidirectional self-attention → O + residual[B,1500,1280]20 heads ×64; O has bias.
↓
LayerNorm → fc1 → GELU → fc2 + residual[B,1500,1280]1280→5120→1280; both Linear layers have bias.

Text decoder block

Three pre-LayerNorm residual branches: causal self-attention, cross-attention and FFN.

Inputs from

LayerNorm → causal self-attention + residual[B,T,1280]Q/K/V/O are all 1280→1280; 20 heads×64; only K is bias-free.
↓
LayerNorm → cross-attention + residualQ:[B,20,T,64]; K/V:[B,20,1500,64]Q comes from current text; K/V come from the final audio representation. Q/K/V/O are each 1280→1280; only K is bias-free.
↓
LayerNorm → fc1 → GELU → fc2 + residual[B,T,1280]1280→5120→1280; both Linear layers have bias.

  • Official HF safetensors contain 1,543,490,560 stored tensor elements, including 1,920,000 fixed audio sinusoidal positional values. Native OpenAI code registers these as a buffer, so they are excluded from learnable parameters.
  • Preprocessing STFT, Mel filters, logarithm, GELU, softmax, masks, fixed positional encoding and KV cache are excluded from parameter counts.
  • HF checkpoint names are used to verify dimensions; native OpenAI code determines the learnable-parameter scope.
  • The standard audio window is 30 seconds; longer audio is handled by external chunking/transcription, not multiple encoder weight sets.
